homeHeadline: Software Engineer by Craft. AI Engineer by Obsession.
homeSummary: I'm Rizki. Craft is how I build and keep it solid. Obsession is why I keep going. I started with software people can trust, and now I build software that thinks, too. The tools changed. The standards didn't.
experienceBiHighlight1: Develop an executive dashboard and business intelligence web application for a global Japanese water-treatment company that puts data from scattered spreadsheets and reports in one place so senior managers can base long-term, mid-term, and annual plan decisions on data.
experienceBiHighlight2: Gave executives one view of the global business by building a 3D globe and 2D map with D3 that show sales, headcount, and contribution for each region and group company.
experienceBiHighlight3: Made market position clear at a glance by comparing the company with six listed competitors on financial ratio trends, share prices, and financials, with all figures convertible to JPY, USD, or EUR.
experienceBiHighlight4: Helped managers connect business results to outside conditions by visualizing seven macroeconomic indicators by country and year, sales mix heat maps by region, industry, and business, and indicators such as crude oil prices, water tariffs, and electricity generation mix.
experienceBiHighlight5: Kept executive data secure by adding Microsoft Entra ID single sign-on and a GitLab DevSecOps pipeline with secret detection, SAST, dependency scanning, and DAST, where high findings stop the release.
experienceAiOpsHighlight1: Develop an internal engineering operations platform that makes AI-assisted work auditable across the whole development lifecycle, where AI does the work inside each stage and a human approves every gate between stages, with an MCP server that lets AI agents such as Claude and Cursor plan, review, and test with the platform's data directly.
experienceAiOpsHighlight2: Replaced guesswork in planning by generating task breakdowns and estimates from real codebase analysis, with tree-sitter parsing across about 10 languages and vector search on pgvector.
experienceAiOpsHighlight3: Reduced the review burden of AI-generated code by reviewing GitLab and GitHub merge requests with AI against each project's own rules and handbook, with automatic merge request documentation and merge scores.
experienceAiOpsHighlight4: Made QA accessible to testers without coding skills by letting them write test cases in plain language, generate them with AI, run them in the cloud, and track coverage.
experienceAiOpsHighlight5: Gave leadership traceable visibility into health, cost, compliance, quality trends, and AI adoption, with every metric linked back to its source.
experienceClaudeCodeHighlight1: Develop a custom Claude Code plugin for the customer's development team to rebuild a vibe-coded proof of concept into a production-ready system after the original vendor left the project.
experienceClaudeCodeHighlight2: Standardized how the team builds with Claude Code by packaging skills, subagents, commands, rules, coding standards, and ADRs into one reusable plugin.
experienceClaudeCodeHighlight3: Improved code quality and agent reliability by enforcing guardrails with hooks and measuring agent output with evals.
experienceClaudeCodeHighlight4: Established a test strategy for unit, integration, and E2E tests, with a clear split between what Claude Code handles and what humans review.
experienceClaudeCodeHighlight5: Enabled a team with no prior AI coding agent experience to deliver with Claude Code from day one by defining a structured documentation tree and an operational policy for human and agent collaboration.
experienceFrontendStandardHighlight1: Maintain the customer's frontend development standard to standardize development across their React projects, delivered as a private UI and design system library, a version-controlled handbook aligned with the official React guidelines, a template app, and a sample app.
experienceFrontendStandardHighlight2: Enabled teams to ship consistent UI faster by maintaining a private UI and design system library on Material UI and Emotion, documented in Storybook and protected by Chromatic visual tests.
experienceFrontendStandardHighlight3: Accelerated new project kickoff by providing a React template app with routing, state management, forms, i18n, authentication, and testing ready to use from the first commit.
experienceFrontendStandardHighlight4: Shortened the learning curve for new developers by building a React sample app that demonstrates the handbook's practices and the library's capabilities in working code.
experienceLogisticsAftersalesHighlight1: Develop a logistics aftersales management service for admin, customers, and dealers to make better use of aftersales data to optimize maintenance schedules, predict potential issues, proactively address customer concerns, and cost savings.
experienceLogisticsAftersalesHighlight2: Facilitated easier data collection by creating intuitive forms and table for vehicle, customer, dealer, spare part, promotional campaigns, and service booking.
experienceLogisticsAftersalesHighlight3: Simplified the vehicle calculation process and presented meaningful information for customer by establishing service credit simulation.
experienceLogisticsAftersalesHighlight4: Improving content authoring flexibility and user engagement by implementing a rich text editor for user education content.
experienceLogisticsOperationalHighlight1: Develop a logistics operational management service for admin and drivers to make planning and organizing the shipping process easier and reliable.
experienceLogisticsOperationalHighlight2: Improving visibility, trackability and schedules more efficiently by implementing real-time tracking of the delivery process.
experienceLogisticsOperationalHighlight3: Improving driver engagement and operational efficiency by establishing driver contest features.
experienceLogisticsOperationalHighlight4: Enabling faster job order processing and reducing training time for customers by enhancing user interface and experience in job order scheduler and dispatcher.
experienceLogisticsOperationalHighlight5: Facilitated easier data aggregation allowing for more accurate insights by implementing data reports for various important metrics.

aboutDescription: About Tri Rizeki Rifandani — background, focus, and how to get in touch.
aboutHeadline: Hi! I'm Rizki, a software engineer based in Indonesia.
aboutParagraph1: My first line of code didn't run in a browser. It ran on a tiny Arduino board. I was 20, a mechatronics student in Yogyakarta, a long way from home in Balikpapan, and I was hooked the moment the hardware did what I told it to. One project led to IoT. IoT led to the web. No roadmap, just curiosity. I taught myself HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, one broken page at a time.
aboutParagraph2: That's when it clicked. The web was powerful, surprisingly easy to understand, and anyone, anywhere, could open what I built. I wanted more. I went through a tech bootcamp and online courses like Dicoding, picked up React for the front end and Node.js for the back end, and suddenly one language took me all the way from the button to the database. Now that same curiosity is pulling me into AI.
aboutParagraph3: Friends and teammates would tell you I come prepared, I jump at new challenges, and I love to share what I learn. Away from the keyboard, you'll find me lifting weights, running, playing games, or playing chess.
aboutParagraph4: Prefer to keep learning, continue challenging myself, and do interesting things that matter. I'm always open to collaborating on exciting projects and innovative/disruptive ideas.
aboutSkill1: Products that ship. I take ideas from a rough sketch to a live product and keep them in good condition after launch.
aboutSkill2: Teams that move faster. I make shared foundations that decrease rework, keep quality consistent, and make each new feature easier to build.
aboutSkill3: Experiences for everyone. I make products that are fast, clear, and accessible, so more people can use them and get their tasks done.
aboutSkill4: AI with real value. I add AI where it saves people time, and I make sure that it works reliably outside the demo.
aboutSkill5: Curiosity that compounds. I learn fast, share what I find, and leave every team a little smarter than when I joined.
